units.source_text: ……亢奋好不容易平静下来时，我的脑子里又浮现出他善的喜悦的企念。

en.t: ...When my excitement had finally calmed down, the thought of his joyful goodness rose again in my mind.

units.source_text: 我想，喜欢抽烟的老师会多么高兴地接受这份礼物啊！

en.t: I thought how gladly the teacher, who liked to smoke, would accept this gift!

units.source_text: 个中原委，他什么也不知道。

en.t: As for the circumstances behind it, he knew nothing at all.
